lines.text: Nice meeting you, see you around!

data.define: A casual goodbye when you will meet again some day.

example.text: Nice meeting you, see you around!

misuse.text: Don't say 'see you around' to set a meeting.
misuse.why: It's vague, with no fixed time.

publish.title: What does "see you around" mean?
publish.value: See you around = Goodbye for now. Example: "Nice meeting you, see you around!" (casual English).
